name: Mazludeh
body:
Mother of Hearth and Wall
Source Distant Shores pg. 23
Pathfinder Wiki Mazludeh
Details
Alignment NG
Pantheon Other Deities
Areas of Concern Balance, community, negotiation, and twilight
Domains Artifice, Community, Good, Knowledge
Subdomains Agathion, Archon (Good), Azata (Good), Cooperation, Family, Memory
* Requires the Acolyte of Apocrypha trait.
Favored Weapon Heavy shield
Symbol Seven eggs encircled by a snake eating its own tail
Sacred Animal(s) Anaconda
